BATCH w1-b1, unit U1 plans-subscriptions, one PR. Lakebase branch mig-p1-w1-b1 from the merged wave-0 branch mig-p1-w0-b1 (U0 inherited, never recreated). Sibling batch w1-b2 (U2 usage-events) runs concurrently in its own branch; do not touch USAGE_EVENTS or usage.*. Lakebase branch mig-p1-w1-b1 created from the merged wave-0 branch mig-p1-w0-b1 (U0 objects inherited, never recreated). U1 plans-subscriptions: tables SUBSCRIPTIONS (FKs to tenants, plans), SUBSCRIPTIONS_HIST (hist_dt varchar(20) string date, upper-cased 'DD-MON-YY HH24:MI:SS'), sequence seq_subscriptions_hist CACHE 1, triggers trg_subscriptions_hist (AFTER UPDATE OR DELETE, OLD row copy) and trg_sub_no_uncancel (BEFORE UPDATE OF status_cd: OLD 30 stays 30); PKG_PLANS -> plans.fn_list_plans() RETURNS TABLE, plans.fn_entitlement(text,date) RETURNS TABLE with ORDER BY starts_on DESC, id (determinism rule R4), plans.sp_change_plan(text,text,date) with SELECT ... FOR UPDATE, ends_on = effective_on - 1, md5-derived id via util.f_md5_uuid, util.log_msg calls preserved; LEAST/GREATEST NULL semantics ported explicitly (R2); TO_DATE('31-DEC-99') -> date '2099-12-31'. Recon tiers 1,2 (COUNT by status_cd),3,4 (fn_entitlement + fn_list_plans for all 69 tenants at the pin vs Lakebase),5,7; Tier 6 (CDC lag/ordering, cdc_lag_max_s 60) runs against the Debezium landing in /Volumes/ow_tp/bronze/landing/cdc/<TABLE>/ (host-side sink, D10-12) once the parent has confirmed it is populated; until then Tier 6 is skipped/no_cdc and recorded as such. Declared source rows at pin: SUBSCRIPTIONS 69, SUBSCRIPTIONS_HIST 0. Delta copy ow_tp.silver.subscriptions_hist from the pin (analytical: exact counts/keys, timestamps to the second). mapping_spec: subscriptions watermark none (strict), subscriptions_hist watermark hist_dt (parsed), identity hist_id. PR ow_tp_u1_plans_subscriptions.

BATCH w1-b2, unit U2 usage-events, one PR. Lakebase branch mig-p1-w1-b2 from the merged wave-0 branch mig-p1-w0-b1 (U0 inherited, never recreated). Sibling batch w1-b1 (U1) runs concurrently in its own branch; do not touch SUBSCRIPTIONS or plans.*. U2 usage-events: table USAGE_EVENTS (FK tenants), trigger trg_usage_events_check (units<=0 -> ERRCODE 'P0001' message 'units must be > 0'; unknown kind -> 'P0002' 'unknown usage kind <n>'; document the -20001/-20002 mapping in the PR), new surface usage.ingest_usage_event(p_id text, p_tenant_id text, p_occurred_at timestamp, p_units bigint, p_kind_cd smallint) = INSERT ... ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING (D3-1 contract; fixture-tested only, no source comparison). Recon tiers 1,2 (SUM(units) by kind_cd),3,4 (negative trigger cases on fixture),5,7. Declared source rows at pin: USAGE_EVENTS 814. mapping_spec: watermark occurred_at, identity none. PR ow_tp_u2_usage_events. TIER 6 (D10-12, DEC-C4a): the CDC read path is a host-side Kafka sink on the Oracle host writing Debezium change events as newline JSON to /Volumes/ow_tp/bronze/landing/cdc/<TABLE>/ (parent implements via the Databricks Files API as the SP; no public 9092). Tier 6 reads that landing (lag = event source_ts vs applied_at, ordering by SCN per PK, cdc_lag_max_s 60) only after the parent confirms it is populated; otherwise record Tier 6 skipped/no_cdc. Never read Kafka directly.
